propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic pin per direct child and per normalized prerequisite, using canonical ticket IDs and 16-hex material fingerprints.
PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all store tickets including archived states to discover arbitrary inbound blockers, then normalize and deduplicate relations by role and canonical ID.

Pin collection must run before prerequisite LLM evaluation and raise PlanRelationSnapshotError with exact enumerated reasons (missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, store-read-failure) without emitting partial pins.

tracker_head_sha() must verify a clean tickets-tracker HEAD after ensure_fresh using git status and git ls-files -u, then return 40-hex SHA or raise store-read-failure for any git/IO/path/output errors.

Ordinary sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, and resign_plan_review must all call collect_plan_relation_snapshot and emit complete current pin sets; deleted targets prevent refresh/re-sign until relationship repair.
Legacy manifests without pins must remain readable; new readers must authenticate the complete stored DSSE manifest including unknown pin lines, then ignore only those lines for field interpretation.
